public_threshold_paper_constants.L_star: 1+ln(2) = 1.693147180559945... (the source intentionally uses natural ln here)

sign_indicator_mapping.choice: g=(1-f)/2, so g=1 exactly where f=-1
sign_indicator_mapping.warning: The raw squares ghat(S)^2 have total mass mu, not 1; their raw entropy is not Shannon entropy until normalized.

influence.oriented_boundary_warning: A convention counting each undirected boundary edge once and dividing by 2^n equals I_i(f)/2; it is not the campaign directional influence.

variance_and_empty_atom.normalized_nonempty_law: Q(S)=P_f(S)/v for S nonempty when v>0
variance_and_empty_atom.raw_nonempty_entropy: sum_{S nonempty} P_f(S) log_2(1/P_f(S))=v H(Q)+v log_2(1/v)
variance_and_empty_atom.endpoint: When v=0, f is constant; use H=I=0 and do not form Q or H/I.

character_multiplication.influence: I(chi_U f)=I(f)+|U|-2 sum_{i in U} I_i(f)
character_multiplication.warning: Character multiplication preserves H but not I; a character chi_U has I=|U| and becomes constant after multiplying by chi_U.

zero_terms: Use 0 log_2(1/0)=0 and omit any ratio whose denominator is zero.
